G2103.name: Eubulus
G2103.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2103.brief: Greeted by Paul in his letter to Timothy.
G2103.short: Eubulus was a Christian who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter.

G2131G.name: Eunice
G2131G.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2131G.brief: Mother of Timothy; a Jewish believer.
G2131G.short: Eunice was the mother of Timothy and a Jewish believer.

G2136.name: Euodia
G2136.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2136.brief: Christian woman in Philippi; urged by Paul to reconcile.
G2136.short: Euodia was a Christian woman in Philippi whom Paul urged to reconcile with Syntyche.

G2161.name: Eutychus
G2161.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2161.brief: Young man in Troas; fell from window; restored by Paul.
G2161.short: Eutychus was a young man in Troas who fell from a window and was restored to life by Paul.

G2195.name: Zacchaeus
G2195.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2195.brief: Tax collector who hosted Jesus in Jericho
G2195.short: Zacchaeus, a wealthy tax collector, hosted Jesus in his home and experienced a transformative encounter.

G2199G.name: Zebedee
G2199G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2199G.brief: Father of the apostles James and John
G2199G.short: Zebedee was the father of James and John, two of Jesus' twelve apostles, and was a fisherman by trade.

G2197H.name: Zechariah
G2197H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2197H.brief: Priest, father of John the Baptist
G2197H.short: Zechariah, a priest of the division of Abijah, was the father of John the Baptist and husband of Elizabeth.

G2181.name: Ephesus
G2181.brief: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity
G2181.short: Ephesus, a major city in Asia Minor, was an important center for early Christianity and the recipient of one of Paul's epistles.

G2117.name: Straight
G2117.brief: Street in Damascus where Saul stayed after conversion
G2117.short: Straight, a street in Damascus where Saul stayed in the house of Judas after his conversion (<ref="Act.9.11">Act.9.11</ref>).
